narr: Scattered showers and thunderstorms developed across the area with a few reports of trees down. In addition, a slow moving storm over Thomasville produced numerous reports of flash flooding.
ev: Flooding was reported on Smith Ave just west of the Highway 19 and Highway 84 exit. The outer lanes were flooded and blocked with traffic rerouted.
Tuxedo Drive and Executive Drive were flooded.
S Hansell Street at S Broad Street was flooded.
Remington Ave at West Jackson Street near the railroad was flooded.
Neel Street was flooded between MLK Drive and West Jackson Street.
Smith Ave at Kern Street was flooded at the entrance to the Farmer's Market area.
Numerous road were flooded around Thomasville with a few vehicles stalled in the flood waters.
N Spair Street was flooded at E Monroe Street.
Water was flowing across Highway 111 near Dunn Road.
